addressGoes: Linear's Settings → API → Create webhook, with Comments among its events; its signing secret is LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET

settings.description: The bot's name in Linear, as people @mention it.

why.addressGoes: The adapter makes no call that registers a webhook. Its README has a workspace admin make one by hand (Settings > API > Create webhook), with Comments under its data change events. Linear's API can make one too (the webhookCreate mutation: url, resourceTypes, a team or allPublicTeams, and the secret), with an admin's key.
why.settings: The adapter answers only a comment that mentions its userName, which is LINEAR_BOT_USERNAME or else the made-up linear-bot.
